description: This file defines event argument classes and delegate types related to gateway connection events within the Orleans distributed application framework. It contains handlers for connection loss and gateway count changes, emphasizing the GatewayCountChangedEventArgs class which encapsulates data about current and previous gateway connection counts.

classes.name: GatewayCountChangedEventArgs
classes.description: Encapsulates event data about the number of connected gateways, including detection of connection recovery scenario.

methods.name: GatewayCountChangedEventArgs
methods.description: Constructor initializing the number of connected gateways and previous counts.
